# tomekdot — GitHub Portfolio & Technical Articles

> An interactive developer showcase and research journal featuring PyPlanet and Openplanet plugins, Trackmania tools, agentic AI systems, and academic computer science projects by Tomasz Kaczak (@tomekdot).

## Overview
- Developer: Tomasz Kaczak (@tomekdot)
- Website: https://tomekdot.github.io
- Repository Index: 17 indexed open-source repositories (PyPlanet, Openplanet, AngelScript, Python, TypeScript)
- Technical Journal: Research articles exploring server automation, reactive telemetry, and AI systems

## AI Catalog & Agentic Resource Discovery
- ARD v1.0 Catalog: https://tomekdot.github.io/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- ARD Schema Identifier: `urn:air:tomekdot.github.io:portfolio:repositories`
- Supported AI Models: Google Gemini (Gemini Flash Latest), Ollama (Local PC / Server), LM Studio

## Key Repositories
- [hermes-my-github-plugin](https://github.com/tomekdot/hermes-my-github-plugin): PyPlanet automation plugin providing server stats, telemetry hooks, and administrative tools.
- [trackmania-galaxy](https://github.com/tomekdot/trackmania-galaxy): Interactive Trackmania galaxy encyclopedia and map dataset explorer.
- [pursuit-maps](https://github.com/tomekdot/pursuit-maps): ManiaPlanet Feedback S1 E1 pursuit maps collection with UIDs, thumbnails, and telemetry metadata.
- [vscode-github-repository-search](https://github.com/tomekdot/vscode-github-repository-search): VS Code extension for fast repository discovery and local clone automation.

## Technical Journal Articles
- [Systemy Agentowe i Autonomia](https://tomekdot.github.io/#journal-agentic): Architecture of autonomous agents, deterministic tools, and memory management.
- [Optymalizacja Wydajności i Silniki Sieciowe](https://tomekdot.github.io/#journal-perf): Async event loops in Python/PyPlanet and zero-overhead AngelScript telemetry in Trackmania.
- [Bazy Danych i Grafy Wiedzy](https://tomekdot.github.io/#journal-graphs): Graph visualization, orbital constellation maps, and relational modeling.
